text.tspan: Bar codes lifted from the DS2278 Product Reference Guide (MN-002915). Scan them straight off this page.
1. Re-bond the scanner to a relay board
Do this after moving the gun to a different ESP32. A BLE bond is stored per-host: the old board's bond does NOT transfer.
Scan TOP first, then BOTTOM. Then power-cycle the relay and watch its /status for barcode.connected: true.
Unpair the digital scanner from the cradle or PC/host to make the cradle available for pairing with another digital
scanner. Scan the bar code below to disconnect the digital scanner from its cradle/PC host.
If the digital scanner is configured for Toggle Pairing, scanning the Pairing bar code a second time unpairs the
When a digital scanner disconnects from a cradle due to a Link Supervision Timeout, the digital scanner
immediately attempts to reconnect to the cradle for 30 seconds. If the auto-reconnect process fails, it can be
restarted by pulling the digital scanner trigger.
To guarantee that a disconnected digital scanner can reconnect when it comes back in range, the cradle reserves
the connection for that digital scanner for a period of time defined by the Connection Maintenance Interval. To
connect another digital scanner: either wait until the connection maintenance interval expires then scan the
bar code on the cradle with the new digital scanner; or, scan
When unpairing the digital scanner In Bluetooth Low Energy mode the host may issue a connection back
to the digital scanner after digital scanner disconnects.
The Connection Maintenance Interval only applies in locked pairing mode (see
The cradle stores the remote pairing address of each digital scanner in memory regardless of the digital
scanner condition (e.g., discharged battery). When you want to change the digital scanners paired to the
cradle, unpair each digital scanner currently connected to the cradle by scanning the
prior and reconnect each appropriate digital scanner by scanning the PAIR bar code on the cradle.
Drops the old host. Safe even if nothing is paired.

Puts the gun back in BLE HID mode + advertising.
Do NOT scan "HID Bluetooth Classic" (it sits just above [2] in the guide, PRG 6-6). It switches the gun to Classic BT,
which the NimBLE firmware cannot see at all - the relay will simply never find it.
Only if [2] alone doesn't get it advertising. General is the factory default; Limited lasts 30 s then stops.

when initiating connection from a PC.

The device remains in Limited Discoverable Mode for 30 seconds, and green LEDs flash while in this mode.
It is then non-discoverable. To re-active Limited Discoverable Mode, press the trigger.
